sid_items_IronsightEnabler_description: Disables the side-mounted rail, allowing for unhindered use of a weapon's iron sights.
sid_items_MagpulIronsightEnabler_descrip: These lightweight, flip-up iron sights, currently in their collapsed configuration, provide a reliable backup aiming solution in case of optic failure.
sid_items_EN_Silen_3Alt_description: Suppresses the blast produced by the firing of certain NATO assault rifles, reducing the likelihood of detection.
sid_items_RU_Silen_2Alt_description: Suppresses the blast produced when firing AK-pattern assault rifles, reducing the likelihood of detection.
sid_items_RU_ColimScope_1Mini_descriptio: Designed for Eastern Bloc firearms, the OCS is favored for its simplicity and versatility, the Open Collimator Sight enables quick, intuitive target acquisition. Its open-frame design provides an unobstructed field of view, ideal for close-quarters combat. The illuminated reticle adapts seamlessly to changing light conditions, ensuring reliable accuracy.
sid_items_EN_ColimScope_1Mini_descriptio: A compact collimator sight for stalkers needing precision and speed in combat. Its enclosed design and illuminated reticle make aiming intuitive and effective in various lighting conditions. Best suited for close-to-medium ranges, it prioritizes quick response without sacrificing accuracy.
sid_items_OXA_ENGoloScope_description: The Leupold Carbine Optic facilitates rapid target re-acquisition with each shot thanks to it's open field of view, which keeps the operator's peripheral vision clear of knobs, dials, or the scope housing. The LCO's 1-MOA dot stands out regardless of environmental conditions, making it a potent option in almost all close-quarter engagements.
sid_items_OXA_HoloScope_1_description: A cutting-edge holographic sight offering a clear, fast-acquisition reticle ideal for close-quarters combat. Its durable housing and integrated brightness adjustments ensure reliability in harsh conditions.
sid_items_OXA_X2Scope_1_description: A high-performance red dot sight known for its rugged construction and exceptional battery life. Though lacking magnification, it excels in rapid target acquisition for mid-range engagements.
sid_items_OXA_ENX2Scope_description: A compact optical sight designed for mid-range engagements, favored by stalkers who need a balance between precision and situational awareness. Featuring a 2x magnification and a durable, lightweight frame, it provides a clear sight picture without adding excessive bulk to a weapon.
sid_items_OXA_RUX2Scope_description: Based on the venerable Aimpoint PRO, the IX2 is a reliable and cost-effective red dot sight designed for professional use. Featuring a durable, shock-resistant frame and integrated 2x magnifier for improved performance at range, it excels at target acquisition in both daylight and low-light conditions.
sid_items_OXA_ENX4Scope_description: A battle-proven optic with 4x magnification, offering excellent clarity and precision for medium to long-range combat. Its illuminated reticle, powered by fiber optics and tritium, eliminates the need for batteries, making it a reliable choice in the unpredictable Zone.
sid_items_OXA_RUX4Scope_description: The PSO-1M2 barely deviates from the tried and tested design of it's predecessor, the PSO-1. This battle-tested telescopic sight, first implemented in the 1960s, utilises a sealed body filled with nitrogen to ensure it remains fog-free at temperatures ranging from -50 to 50°C. Whilst lacking the focus adjustment or parallax control found in higher magnification optics, the PSO-1M2 vastly increases effective range without compromising close-range efficacy.
sid_items_OXA_ENX8Scope_description: A complex and highly adaptable optic, the Schmidt & Bender PMII/LP comes with a price-tag may often exceeds that of the weapon it is mounted on. Designed for use by highly-trained marksmen, it's array of single and double turn turrets allow a capable operator complete and rapid control over windage, elevation, and parallax, ideal for engaging targets at varying distances. Even with it's high-end features and superb optical clarity, it remains extremely durable, vital for withstanding the harsh conditions of the Zone.
sid_items_OXA_RUX8Scope_description: A step-up from the PSO-1M2, this telescopic sight makes the most of the superior long-ranged ballistics of the SVU/SVD. Whilst it lacks the enlarged exit pupil found in more expensive variants, the PSO 8x24M remains an extremely capable optic, facilitating accurate fire at ranges exceeding 1km.
sid_items_OXA_Laser_1_description:
A laser designator facilitates faster, easier aiming at short and medium ranges. Its small form factor allows easy attachment to various firearm rails without adding unnecessary bulk.

 • Aiming Speed: +20%
 • Spread Reduction: -5%
sid_items_OXA_Laser_2_description:
A laser designator facilitates faster, easier aiming at short and medium ranges. The device is built to withstand rough conditions, ensuring reliability.

 • Aiming Speed: +5%
 • Spread Reduction: -20%
sid_items_OXA_Laser_3_description:
A high-performance green laser sight designed for superior target tracking and accuracy. Its crisp, high-visibility beam provides excellent contrast in daylight and low-light scenarios.

 • Recoil Reduction: -10%
 • Spread Reduction: -20%
sid_items_OXA_Laser_4_description: A military-grade aiming module combining infrared and visible laser systems for advanced target acquisition. Its dual-beam function allows seamless switching between covert and overt targeting.
sid_items_Gauss_Scope_description: The proprietary optic utilized on Item 62, better known to stalkers as the Gauss Rifle, designed to enhance its unparalleled range and power.
sid_items_GunGroupRifleTop_description: Assault rifles with top-mounted Picatinny rail
sid_items_GunGroupRifleSide_description: Assault rifles with side-mounted RIS adapter
sid_items_EN_ShotgunSilen_1_description: Reduces the firing volume of the M870
sid_items_RU_ShotgunSilen_1_description: Reduces the firing volume of the Saiga-12K

A specialized barrel attachment designed to redirect gas emissions outward, thereby decreasing vertical recoil. Often used to maintain better control during sustained fire.

 • Recoil Reduction: -15%
sid_items_OXALateralComp_9mm_description:
An attachment focused on minimizing horizontal muzzle movement by redirecting gases to the sides. Often used to decrease general bullet spread.

sid_items_OXABalancedVent_9mm_descriptio:
A hybrid muzzle device designed to provide a balance between recoil control and muzzle rise compensation. Though it does not directly compete with a dedicated Muzzle Brake or Lateral Compensator, it provides the effects of both.

sid_items_OXAGripContoured_description:
An ergonomically shaped foregrip designed to enhance weapon handling and comfort. Its curved design provides a natural grip angle, improving control and reducesing hand fatigue.

 • Aiming Speed: +20%
 • Recoil Recovery +10%
 • Reload Speed: +20%
sid_items_OXAGripStubby_description:
A compact foregrip optimized for agility and quick handling in close-quarters combat. Its short design allows for faster weapon transitions and improved control without adding unnecessary weight.

 • Aiming Speed: +20%
 • Equip Speed: +20%
sid_items_OXAGripWeighted_description:
A reinforced foregrip designed to add stability by counteracting recoil with additional mass. This results in smoother handling and improved accuracy, especially for automatic weapons.

 • Recoil Recovery: +10%
 • Recoil Reduction: -10%
 • Spread Reduction: -10%
sid_items_OXAGripAngled_description:

 • Equip Speed: +10%

sid_upgrades_OXA_Upgrade_Attachment_Grip: A sturdy attachment rail designed to accommodate vertical and angled foregrips for improved weapon control.
sid_upgrades_OXA_Upgrade_Attachment_Lase: A specialized rail system that enables the attachment of laser sights and designators to firearms.
sid_upgrades_OXA_Upgrade_Attachment_Grip: A versatile attachment system. Its dual-rail design allows for simultaneous mounting of both laser and foregrip attachments.
An auxiliary mounting rail situated beneath the handguard. Allows the use of foregrips or underbarrel attachments
sid_items_OXACons_WeaponMaintA_descripti: A high-performance lubricant designed to reduce friction and wear on firearm components. Provides a long-lasting coating that inhibits oxidation and ensures smooth cycling, whilst resisting temperature fluctuations. Essential for regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance.
sid_items_OXACons_WeaponMaintB_descripti: A multifunctional firearm maintenance spray designed to clean carbon buildup, lubricate moving parts, and protect against corrosion. Penetrates deep to remove fouling, leaving a protective layer that reduces wear and moisture damage. Essential for field maintenance, ensuring smoother operation, and prolonging weapon lifespan.
sid_items_OXAGear_WeaponMaintKitT1_descr: A compact weapon maintenance kit containing a small range of essential tools, including a multi-tool, cleaning rod, and a handful of replacement springs and pins. Intended for basic maintenance rather than more complex repairs, it provides a lightweight means of keeping weapons in reasonable condition.
sid_items_OXAGear_WeaponMaintKitT2_descr: A well thought-out maintenance kit, containing a wider range of tools and parts for field-stripping and cleaning a multitude of different firearms, whilst still remaining light enough to carry for long distances. It's improved functionality translates to improved reliability and weapon longevity, vital for prolonged excursions.
sid_items_OXAGear_WeaponMaintKitT3_descr: A complex and weighty kit that would be the envy of any zone technician. An extensive array of specialized parts means a capable operator will always have the right tool for the job, ensuring their weaponry remains in near-perfect condition in the face of an unforgiving environment.
sid_items_OXAGear_WeaponMaintKitT4_descr: An ultrasonic gun cleaner uses high-frequency sound waves and a cleaning solution to remove carbon, dirt, and debris from firearms. The ultrasonic vibrations create microscopic bubbles that penetrate hard-to-reach areas, ensuring a deep, thorough clean. It's safe, fast, and effective... and entirely impractical for the average stalker.
sid_items_OXAGear_ArmorII_description: Para-aramid armor panels - Substantial ballistic protection, able to withstand hits from smaller caliber firearms. Dozens of layers of para-aramid fabric prevent bullet penetration and disperse the associated kinetic energy. Whilst lacking the protection offered by more substantial armor, it is significantly lighter and provides a level of flexibility that is unattainable with more durable plating.
sid_items_OXAGear_ArmorIII_description: UHMWPE armor plates - Formidable ballistic protection, able to withstand multiple hits from most assault rifles. Comprised of multiple sheets of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fused into rigid plates via hydraulic press. UHMWPE provides a higher level of protection than steel whilst remaining substantially lighter. It is also superior in preventing spalling; whilst steel plates can cause rounds to disintegrate into dangerous shrapnel, UHMWPE absorbs these fragments and prevents secondary injury.
sid_items_OXAGear_ArmorIV_description: Ceramic armor plates - Advanced ballistic prevention, rated to withstand armor-piercing rounds. Projectile penetration is prevented by a network of extremely hard ceramic tiles, and a UHMWPE backing layer disperses the energy of the projectile and limits the impact of blunt force trauma. It's superior performance comes at a cost; these incredibly durable panels are around 1 inch thick, rendering them completely inflexible and amounting to a substantial weight.
sid_items_OXAGear_RespI_description: A basic yet reliable filter designed for common airborne threats in the form of contaminated particulates or gaseous chemicals. Utilizing activated carbon and particulate filtration, it provides essential respiratory protection whilst remaining lightweight and easily replaced; a staple for many a cautious stalker.
sid_items_OXAGear_RespII_description: Enhanced with high-efficiency particulate and chemical filtration, this filter neutralizes toxic gases, biological agents, and other contaminants. Designed for hazardous environments, it ensures prolonged protection with an extended lifespan, and superior performance make it swift upgrade for stalkers who intend on surviving the Zone.
sid_items_OXAGear_RespIII_description: A top-tier filter engineered for prolonged exposure to the complex array of chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats present in the Zone. With nanofiber technology and advanced reactive materials, it offers maximum protection in extreme conditions, offering unparalleled safety against the deadliest of airborne hazards.
sid_items_OXAGear_LiningCE_description: A collection of chemically resistant elastomer inserts which provide protection against both electrical and chemical hazards. Whilst relatively flexible, they offer little in terms of breathability; an over-exerted wearer will soon find themselves struggling due with the accumulated heat.
sid_items_OXAGear_LiningTE_description: With a core of vermiculite fiberglass fabric, this durable lining provides exceptional thermal protection. The external coating was originally included for the reflection of radiant heat, but once it found its way into the hands of stalkers it was soon discovered to function as a makeshift Faraday cage, providing a safe path for electrostatic discharge. Despite its benefits, many find such an insulating material to be a hindrance under sustained exertion.
sid_items_OXAGear_LiningRad_description: A thin, metallic material designed to inhibit the passage of radioactive particles. It sacrifices some level of protection in exchange for remaining flexible and lightweight.
sid_items_OXAGear_DumpPouch_description: A large pouch for the rapid deposition of spent magazines, reducing the total time required to reload. A mesh base prevents the accumulation of dirt and moisture, and elasticated straps prevent the contents from rattling.
sid_items_OXAGear_AmmoPouch_description: Secure storage for magazines of various sizes. Comprised of a double layer of 500D Cordura, retention is ensured with adjustable side panels and securing bungee strap. This organised system of ammo storage facilitates rapid reloads, and the improved weight distribution reduces fatigue when travelling long distances.
sid_items_OXAGear_Boots_description: A pair of sturdy yet lightweight combat boots, designed for prolonged excursions.
sid_items_OXAGear_HydrationBasic_descrip: Comprised of a refillable bladder and flexible drinking tube, this hydration pack provides a simple but effective way of ensuring stalkers maintain an adequate fluid intake whilst on the move.
sid_items_OXAGear_HydrationAdv_descripti: A somewhat over-engineered hydration pack; with the bladder held close the wearer's body, small fluid pumps circulate its contents through flexible pipes which run across the outer surface of the wearer's clothing. With adequately cool external conditions, the result is a surprisingly effective means of eliminating excess body heat, that doubles as a supply of clean drinking water.
sid_items_OXAGear_AutoClot_description: By utilising a combination of vasoactive medications and targeted electrostimulation, this device stems blood loss by causing damaged vessels to contract rapidly. Secondary medications supplement the clotting cascade and accelerate the healing process, as well as the user's metabolic rate.
sid_items_OXAGear_AutoHeal_description: An experimental system which reduces inflammation, accelerates coagulation, and promotes wound healing. Rumored to originate from the labs of SIRCAA, it bears resemblance to an extracorporeal membrane oxygenation device, augmented by an unknown artefact. The immediate benefits to combat personnel are obvious, but the long-term impact of such technology remains to be determined.
sid_items_OXAGear_AutoStim_description: The product of recently unearthed documents from the X-Lab network, revitalized by the renewed efforts of SIRCAA. Developed to augment combat personnel, this device accelerates audiovisual processing and neuronal response times, improving the reflexes and reaction times of the user. Despite its benefits, the device renders the operator particularly vulnerable to harmful psy radiation.
sid_items_OXAGear_HealthBoost_descriptio: A complex array of psy-emitters, potentiated by intravenously-administered neuroactive compounds, almost completely eliminates the users sense of pain. Rumoured to be the product of extensive reverse-engineering of Monolith technology procured by SIRCAA personnel.
sid_items_OXAGear_ReduceSleep_descriptio: The myriad threats of the zone are relentless; those that survive it must be even more so. This device was developed for extended operations into the heart of the zone, where a momentary lapse in concentration could spell disaster. Utilising an array of emissive electrodes adhered to the operator’s cranium, this device disrupts the natural circadian rhythm of the brain, effectively deceiving the body into a constant state of wakefulness. Whilst effective, users must remember that sleep is vital for the body, and prolonged use is medically questionable.
sid_items_OXAGear_PsyDamp_description: Whilst the project X laboratories were notorious for their research into the use of psy fields to control subjects, they were also engaged in parallel efforts to develop technologies to resist those same effects. The more cautious amongst researchers developed psy-dampening emitters for personal protection, and it wasn’t long before such devices found their way into the hands of equally cautious stalkers.
sid_items_OXAGear_RadFilter_description: A ruggedised medical device which counteracts the effects of harmful radiation. With SIRCAA personnel being constantly exposed to the hazards of the Zone, there is a strong desire within the organisation to develop an effective means of countering the constant threat of radiation poisoning. Whilst far from perfect, this device works by actively filtering the blood and administering automated doses of anti-radiation medication. Despite the benefits, the requirement for strong anticoagulant medications means it is a particularly risky option for combat personnel.
sid_items_OXAGear_NVG1_description: The AN/PVS-14 Monocular Night Vision Device (MNVD) is a compact, lightweight, and rugged night vision system. Utilizing a single high-performance image intensifier tube, it provides enhanced visibility in low-light environments. Whilst its image may not be as clear as that of more advanced devices, it nonetheless improves situational awareness when operating under cover of darkness. Its durable, waterproof construction ensures reliability in harsh conditions, making this tool a valuable addition in the Zone.
sid_items_OXAGear_NVG2_description: The AN/PVS-31 Binocular Night Vision Device (BNVD) is a lightweight, dual-tube night vision system designed for military and tactical operations. Offering improved depth perception and situational awareness when compared to monocular systems, it improves the user's ability to acquire and identify targets in low-light environments, as well as easing navigation when traversing the Zone at night.
sid_items_OXAGear_NVG3_description: The Ground Panoramic Night Vision Goggle (GPNVG) is an advanced quad-tube night vision system designed to provide unparalleled situational awareness in low-light environments. Featuring four image intensifier tubes arranged in a panoramic configuration, it offers an expanded 97-degree field of view; nearly double that of a binocular systems. This wider view reduces the need for excessive head movement, enhancing operational effectiveness when threats could appear from any angle. The improved field of view, in combination with it's superior image quality, makes the GPNVG-18 a highly-desirable asset to even the most seasoned of stalkers.

sid_items_GunM16_MagIncreased_descriptio:
A high-capacity drum magazine that can be utilised by a number of assault rifles. Whilst more prone to feed malfunctions than traditional magazines, it makes up for it by doubling ammunition capacity.

sid_items_GunFora_MagIncreased_descripti:
An extended magazine compatible with a number of rifles produced by both Heckler & Koch and IWI. Its unique design supports both 5.45 and 5.56 caliber cartridges, eliminating the need to swap magazines when changing the weapon’s caliber.

sid_items_GunLavina_MagIncreased_descrip:
This extended magazine transforms the AS Val into a fully-fledged assault rifle. This magazine hasn’t gained widespread popularity among Zone veterans, primarily owing to the added weight of the special 9x39mm caliber ammunition.

sid_items_GunGvintar_MagIncreased_descri:

sid_items_GunD12_MagPaired_description:

sid_items_GunD12_MagIncreased_descriptio:
An extended magazine for the Saiga smoothbore shotgun. Perfect for facing a pack of Fleshes or a group of bandits when you’d rather not bother with frequent reloading.

sid_items_GunD12_MagLarge_description:
For a semi-automatic shotgun, nothing beats a high-capacity magazine — except maybe a drum magazine with even greater capacity! Perfect for annihilating anything that moves.

sid_items_GunSVU_MagIncreased_descriptio:

sid_items_GunMark_MagIncreased_descripti:
